metadata.title: VSICO Hue Port | Sea Gateway of the East–West Economic Corridor (EWEC)
metadata.description: VSICO Chan May Hue deep-water seaport and integrated cross-border logistics hub connected to ICD Lao Bao in Central Vietnam.

nav.menuContactSubtitle: Chan May – Lang Co Economic Zone, Hue City

berthSpecs.title: International deep-water standard welcoming large-tonnage vessels
berthSpecs.summary: 540 m of continuous quay length with a -14 m draft, engineered to simultaneously accommodate 4,000 TEU container ships and 70,000 DWT general cargo vessels.
berthSpecs.quayLengthSub: Length guarantees simultaneous docking of 2 large vessels
berthSpecs.depthSub: Deep, stable draft independent of tidal cycles
berthSpecs.areaSub: Container yards, CFS warehouses, closed conveyor & logistics
berthSpecs.vesselSummary: Berth No. 4 & No. 5 technical infrastructure is engineered for large-scale vessel classes:
berthSpecs.containerVesselDesc: Accommodates container vessels up to 4,000 TEU, speeding up turnaround with Weihua 45t-45m quay cranes.
berthSpecs.bulkVesselDesc: Accommodates bulk carriers up to 70,000 DWT, featuring an enclosed conveyor system for environmental protection.
berthSpecs.officialPlanningNote: Port infrastructure approved under official Chan May – Lang Co Economic Zone planning.

location.title: Where the Sea Meets the Economic Corridor
location.summary: Strategically located at Chan May Port Area, Chan May – Lang Co Economic Zone (Hue City), and about {distanceKm} km from the Lao Bao International Border Gate, VSICO Hue Port connects directly to the East–West Economic Corridor (EWEC), serving as a vital maritime gateway for Southern Laos, Northeast Thailand, and Northern Cambodia.
location.portExactLocationValue: Chan May Port Area, Chan May – Lang Co Economic Zone, Hue City (Coordinates 16.326° N, 107.989° E)

location.scrollZoomHint: Use mouse scroll to zoom in / out
location.ewecCorridorDesc: Cargo flows from Southern Laos, Northeast Thailand, and Northern Cambodia converge through the Lao Bao Border Gate directly to the Chan May deep-water port.
location.selectZoneHint: Select an Industrial Zone to highlight its connection on the map
location.advantageNote: Optimizes domestic transport with stable infrastructure and reduced transshipment risk.

portIcd.summary: VSICO Hue Port is seamlessly connected with ICD Lao Bao (VSICO Quang Tri) spanning {icdArea} m² right next to the Vietnam–Laos border gate, forming a closed-loop operational chain from border to berth.
